title: Holo Foil
description: A draped sheet of holographic foil: view-angle rainbow diffraction, sparkle, a scratched clear coat, bloom and film grain, rendered with three.js.

props.name: material
props.description: baseColor, holoIntensity, holoScale, bandFreq, saturation, hueShift, sparkle, specTint, iridescence, roughness, metalness, clearcoat, coatRoughness, sheen, bump, bumpTiling.

props.name: look
props.description: background, exposure, environment, bloom, bloomThreshold, noise, toneMapping, occlusion, occlusionStrength.

props.name: image
props.description: A full-bleed image printed on the foil; it also sets the sheet's shape.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lean the sheet toward the pointer.

props.name: time
props.description: Freezes the film grain at this time (seconds) and draws only on change, for stills.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Replaces the static picture shown without WebGL 2 or under reduced motion.

a11y: Decorative by default (aria-hidden); with aria-label it is role="img" with that name.
Without WebGL 2, under reduced motion and before the first frame it shows a static CSS picture of a foil sheet.
Pointer lean only changes the picture; nothing needs a pointer.
docs:
Installed `HoloFoil` and its three.js scene in `components/ui/`, plus the `render-loop` helper in `lib/`. Render `<HoloFoil className="rounded-xl" />`; it is 16:10 by default, so size it with `className`.

Pick a `preset` ("holo", "chrome", "black-cloth") and override any dial with `material` and `look`. Print an image on the foil with `image="/poster.png"`. Rendering pauses off screen and in hidden tabs; without WebGL 2 or under reduced motion a static picture shows instead.

Needs `three` (installed) and, for TypeScript, `@types/three`. Ported from dmitrykurash/holocloth (MIT, copyright 2026 Dmitry Kurash): the material only, without the cloth simulation; the license text is in each file.
